# Does your lash price list pay? Profit per chair hour, for every set and fill

> Free lash studio pricing calculator. Enter your price list, supplies, card fees, no-shows and overhead; it shows profit per chair hour for every set and fill, the price that hits your target hourly, and what a client is worth over a lifetime of fills. Private, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
